<script>

// ========================================
// REMOVE SOMEE ELEMENTS
// ========================================

setInterval(function(){
 document.querySelectorAll(
  "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
 ).forEach(function(el){el.remove()});

 document.querySelectorAll(
  "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
 ).forEach(function(el){el.remove()});

 document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(function(el){el.remove()});

 document.querySelectorAll(
  "div[style='height: 65px;']"
 ).forEach(function(el){el.remove()});
},10);

// ========================================
// CONFIG
// ========================================

var winLen=5;
var COLS=0;
var ROWS=0;
var board=[];
var cur=1;
var finished=false;
var winningCells=[];
var mode='pvp';
var names=['Người chơi 1','Người chơi 2'];
var busy=false;
var aiTimer=null;
var lastClickTime=0;

// ========================================
// ELEMENTS
// ========================================

var boardEl=document.getElementById('board');
var boardWrap=document.getElementById('boardWrap');
var p1label=document.getElementById('p1label');
var p2label=document.getElementById('p2label');
var overlay=document.getElementById('overlay');
var modalTitle=document.getElementById('modalTitle');
var modalMsg=document.getElementById('modalMsg');
var fxCanvas=document.getElementById('fxCanvas');

// ========================================
// MENU
// ========================================

function chooseMode(m){
 mode=m;

 document.getElementById('setup').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('pvpFields').hidden=m!=='pvp';
 document.getElementById('pveFields').hidden=m!=='pve';

 document.getElementById('setupTitle').textContent=
  m==='pvp'?'Thông tin hai người chơi':'Thông tin người chơi';

 document.getElementById('name1').value='';
 document.getElementById('name2').value='';
 document.getElementById('userName').value='';

 document.getElementById('setup').scrollIntoView({
  behavior:'smooth',
  block:'nearest'
 });
}

document.getElementById('pvpBtn').onclick=function(){
 chooseMode('pvp');
};

document.getElementById('pveBtn').onclick=function(){
 chooseMode('pve');
};

document.getElementById('backMenu').onclick=function(){
 document.getElementById('setup').hidden=true;
};

document.getElementById('startBtn').onclick=function(){
 if(mode==='pvp'){
  names[0]=document.getElementById('name1').value.trim()||'Người chơi 1';
  names[1]=document.getElementById('name2').value.trim()||'Người chơi 2';
 }else{
  names[0]=document.getElementById('userName').value.trim()||'Người chơi';
  names[1]='Robot';
 }

 document.getElementById('menu').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden=false;

 startGame();
};

// ========================================
// BOARD SIZE
// ========================================

function calculateBoardSize(){
 var width=boardWrap.clientWidth;
 var height=boardWrap.clientHeight;
 var targetCell=52;

 return{
  cols:Math.max(1,Math.floor(width/targetCell)),
  rows:Math.max(1,Math.floor(height/targetCell))
 };
}

function initBoardSize(){
 var size=calculateBoardSize();

 COLS=size.cols;
 ROWS=size.rows;

 board=Array.from({length:ROWS},function(){
  return Array(COLS).fill(0);
 });

 updateBoardCSS();
}

function updateBoardCSS(){
 boardEl.style.setProperty('--cols',COLS);
 boardEl.style.setProperty('--rows',ROWS);
}

function resizeBoard(){
 if(document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden)return;

 var size=calculateBoardSize();
 var newCols=Math.max(COLS,size.cols);
 var newRows=Math.max(ROWS,size.rows);

 if(newCols===COLS&&newRows===ROWS)return;

 var newBoard=Array.from({length:newRows},function(){
  return Array(newCols).fill(0);
 });

 for(var r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
  for(var c=0;c<COLS;c++){
   newBoard[r][c]=board[r][c];
  }
 }

 board=newBoard;
 COLS=newCols;
 ROWS=newRows;

 updateBoardCSS();
 createBoard();
}

// ========================================
// START / RESET GAME
// ========================================

function startGame(){
 stopAI();
 stopFireworks();

 finished=false;
 busy=false;
 cur=1;
 winningCells=[];

 initBoardSize();

 document.getElementById('p1name').textContent=names[0];
 document.getElementById('p2name').textContent=names[1];

 createBoard();
 updateLabels();
 updateTurn();
}

function resetGame(){
 if(document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden)return;

 stopAI();
 stopFireworks();

 board=Array.from({length:ROWS},function(){
  return Array(COLS).fill(0);
 });

 finished=false;
 busy=false;
 cur=1;
 winningCells=[];

 createBoard();
 updateLabels();
 updateTurn();
 overlay.classList.remove('show');
}

function stopAI(){
 if(aiTimer!==null){
  clearTimeout(aiTimer);
  aiTimer=null;
 }
}

// ========================================
// MENU BUTTON
// ========================================

document.getElementById('menuBtn').onclick=function(){
 stopAI();
 stopFireworks();

 overlay.classList.remove('show');
 document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('menu').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('setup').hidden=true;
};

// ========================================
// CREATE BOARD
// ========================================

function createBoard(){
 boardEl.innerHTML='';

 var fragment=document.createDocumentFragment();

 for(var r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
  for(var c=0;c<COLS;c++){
   var b=document.createElement('button');

   b.type='button';
   b.className='cell';
   b.setAttribute('data-r',r);
   b.setAttribute('data-c',c);
   b.setAttribute('aria-label','Ô '+(r+1)+'-'+(c+1));

   if(board[r][c]!==0){
    b.classList.add(board[r][c]===1?'p1':'p2');
    b.textContent=board[r][c]===1?'✕':'◯';
   }

   var isWin=winningCells.some(function(cell){
    return cell[0]===r&&cell[1]===c;
   });

   if(isWin)b.classList.add('win');

   b.addEventListener('click',onCellClick);
   fragment.appendChild(b);
  }
 }

 boardEl.appendChild(fragment);
}

// ========================================
// PLAYER LABELS
// ========================================

function updateLabels(){
 p1label.classList.toggle('active',cur===1);
 p2label.classList.toggle('active',cur===2);
}

function updateTurn(){
 var el=document.getElementById('turn');

 if(busy&&mode==='pve'){
  el.textContent='🤖 Robot đang suy nghĩ...';
  el.className='wait';
  return;
 }

 el.textContent='Đến lượt: '+names[cur-1]+
  (cur===1?' (X)':' (O)');

 el.className=cur===1?'x':'o';
}

// ========================================
// PLACE MOVE
// ========================================

function placeMove(r,c,p){
 if(finished||board[r][c]!==0)return false;

 board[r][c]=p;

 var idx=r*COLS+c;
 var cell=boardEl.children[idx];

 if(cell){
  cell.classList.add(p===1?'p1':'p2');
  cell.textContent=p===1?'✕':'◯';
 }

 var winCells=checkWin(r,c,p);

 if(winCells){
  winningCells=winCells;

  for(var i=0;i<winCells.length;i++){
   var rr=winCells[i][0];
   var cc=winCells[i][1];
   var winIdx=rr*COLS+cc;

   if(boardEl.children[winIdx]){
    boardEl.children[winIdx].classList.add('win');
   }
  }

  finished=true;
  busy=false;

  setTimeout(function(){
   showWin(p);
   startFireworks();
  },600);

  return true;
 }

 cur=cur===1?2:1;
 updateLabels();
 updateTurn();

 return true;
}

// ========================================
// CELL CLICK
// ========================================

function onCellClick(){
 if(finished||busy)return;
 if(mode==='pve'&&cur===2)return;

 var r=Number(this.dataset.r);
 var c=Number(this.dataset.c);

 if(board[r][c]!==0)return;

 if(placeMove(r,c,cur)){
  if(!finished&&mode==='pve'&&cur===2){
   busy=true;
   updateTurn();
   aiTimer=setTimeout(function(){
    aiTimer=null;
    if(finished||document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden)return;

    var move=chooseAIMove();

    if(move){
     placeMove(move[0],move[1],2);
    }

    busy=false;
    updateTurn();
   },350);
  }
 }
}

// ========================================
// CHECK WIN
// ========================================

function checkWin(r,c,p){
 var dirs=[
  [1,0],
  [0,1],
  [1,1],
  [1,-1]
 ];

 for(var i=0;i<dirs.length;i++){
  var dr=dirs[i][0];
  var dc=dirs[i][1];
  var count=1;
  var cells=[[r,c]];

  var rr=r+dr;
  var cc=c+dc;

  while(inBounds(rr,cc)&&board[rr][cc]===p){
   cells.push([rr,cc]);
   count++;
   rr+=dr;
   cc+=dc;
  }

  rr=r-dr;
  cc=c-dc;

  while(inBounds(rr,cc)&&board[rr][cc]===p){
   cells.unshift([rr,cc]);
   count++;
   rr-=dr;
   cc-=dc;
  }

  if(count>=winLen)return cells;
 }

 return null;
}

function inBounds(r,c){
 return r>=0&&r<ROWS&&c>=0&&c<COLS;
}

// ========================================
// AI - CANDIDATE CELLS
// ========================================

function getCandidates(){
 var candidates=[];
 var seen={};

 for(var r=0;r<ROWS;r++){
  for(var c=0;c<COLS;c++){
   if(board[r][c]!==0)continue;

   var near=false;

   for(var dr=-2;dr<=2&&!near;dr++){
    for(var dc=-2;dc<=2;dc++){
     if(dr===0&&dc===0)continue;

     var rr=r+dr;
     var cc=c+dc;

     if(inBounds(rr,cc)&&board[rr][cc]!==0){
      near=true;
      break;
     }
    }
   }

   if(near){
    var key=r+'_'+c;
    if(!seen[key]){
     seen[key]=true;
     candidates.push([r,c]);
    }
   }
  }
 }

 if(candidates.length===0){
  candidates.push([Math.floor(ROWS/2),Math.floor(COLS/2)]);
 }

 return candidates;
}

// ========================================
// AI - SCORE A FIVE-CELL WINDOW
// ========================================

function windowScore(own,enemy){
 if(own>0&&enemy>0)return 0;

 var values=[
  0,
  3,
  30,
  350,
  30000,
  100000000
 ];

 if(own>0)return values[own];

 if(enemy>0)return values[enemy]*1.12;

 return 1;
}

// ========================================
// AI - EVALUATE MOVE
// ========================================

function evaluateMove(r,c,p){
 var enemy=p===1?2:1;
 var dirs=[
  [1,0],
  [0,1],
  [1,1],
  [1,-1]
 ];

 var total=0;

 for(var d=0;d<dirs.length;d++){
  var dr=dirs[d][0];
  var dc=dirs[d][1];

  for(var offset=0;offset<winLen;offset++){
   var startR=r-dr*offset;
   var startC=c-dc*offset;

   var own=0;
   var other=0;
   var valid=true;

   for(var j=0;j<winLen;j++){
    var rr=startR+dr*j;
    var cc=startC+dc*j;

    if(!inBounds(rr,cc)){
     valid=false;
     break;
    }

    var value=(rr===r&&cc===c)?p:board[rr][cc];

    if(value===p)own++;
    else if(value===enemy)other++;
   }

   if(valid)total+=windowScore(own,other);
  }
 }

 return total;
}

// ========================================
// AI - CHOOSE BEST MOVE
// ========================================

function chooseAIMove(){
 var candidates=getCandidates();

 var bestScore=-Infinity;
 var bestMoves=[];

 for(var i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
  var r=candidates[i][0];
  var c=candidates[i][1];

  var attack=evaluateMove(r,c,2);
  var defense=evaluateMove(r,c,1);

  // Ưu tiên thắng ngay, sau đó chặn đối thủ.
  var score=Math.max(attack,defense*1.08)+
   Math.min(attack,defense)*0.15;

  // Ưu tiên các ô gần trung tâm khi điểm bằng nhau.
  var centerR=(ROWS-1)/2;
  var centerC=(COLS-1)/2;

  var distance=Math.abs(r-centerR)+Math.abs(c-centerC);
  score-=distance*0.001;

  if(score>bestScore){
   bestScore=score;
   bestMoves=[[r,c]];
  }else if(score===bestScore){
   bestMoves.push([r,c]);
  }
 }

 if(bestMoves.length===0)return candidates[0];

 return bestMoves[Math.floor(Math.random()*bestMoves.length)];
}

// ========================================
// WIN MODAL
// ========================================

function showWin(player){
 modalTitle.textContent='🏆 Chiến thắng!';
 modalMsg.textContent=names[player-1]+' đã thắng với quân '+
  (player===1?'X':'O')+'!';

 overlay.classList.add('show');
}

document.getElementById('modalRestart').onclick=function(){
 resetGame();
};

document.getElementById('modalMenu').onclick=function(){
 stopAI();
 stopFireworks();
 overlay.classList.remove('show');
 document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden=true;
 document.getElementById('menu').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('setup').hidden=true;
};

document.getElementById('restartBtn').onclick=function(){
 resetGame();
};

// ========================================
// FIREWORKS CANVAS
// ========================================

var ctx;
var W=0;
var H=0;
var dpr=1;
var particles=[];
var animId=null;

function setupCanvas(){
 dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,3);

 W=window.innerWidth;
 H=window.innerHeight;

 fxCanvas.style.width=W+'px';
 fxCanvas.style.height=H+'px';

 fxCanvas.width=Math.round(W*dpr);
 fxCanvas.height=Math.round(H*dpr);

 ctx=fxCanvas.getContext('2d');
 ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
}

function startFireworks(){
 if(!ctx)setupCanvas();

 particles=[];

 for(var i=0;i<8;i++){
  launch(
   Math.random()*W*.8+W*.1,
   Math.random()*H*.4+H*.2
  );
 }

 if(!animId)animId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function stopFireworks(){
 if(animId){
  cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
  animId=null;
 }

 particles=[];

 if(ctx){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
}

function launch(x,y){
 var hue=Math.random()*360;

 for(var i=0;i<80;i++){
  var angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
  var speed=Math.random()*4+1;

  particles.push({
   x:x,y:y,
   vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,
   vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,
   life:Math.random()*60+30,
   age:0,
   hue:hue
  });
 }
}

function loop(){
 ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

 for(var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
  var p=particles[i];

  p.x+=p.vx;
  p.y+=p.vy;
  p.vy+=.04;
  p.age++;

  var alpha=Math.max(0,1-p.age/p.life);

  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
  ctx.beginPath();

  ctx.arc(
   p.x,p.y,
   Math.max(1,2-p.age/30),
   0,Math.PI*2
  );

  ctx.fillStyle='hsl('+p.hue+' '+
   Math.floor(50+alpha*50)+'% 50%)';

  ctx.fill();

  if(p.age>p.life)particles.splice(i,1);
 }

 ctx.globalAlpha=1;

 if(particles.length>0){
  animId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 }else{
  animId=null;
 }
}

// ========================================
// RESIZE
// ========================================

window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
 resizeBoard();
 setupCanvas();
});

// ========================================
// RESTART SHORTCUT
// ========================================

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
 if(
  e.key.toLowerCase()==='r'&&
  !e.ctrlKey&&!e.altKey&&!e.metaKey
 ){
  if(e.target&&(
   e.target.isContentEditable||
   e.target.tagName==='INPUT'||
   e.target.tagName==='TEXTAREA'
  ))return;

  resetGame();
 }
});

// ========================================
// DOUBLE CLICK RESTART
// ========================================

boardEl.addEventListener('dblclick',function(){
 if(document.getElementById('gameScreen').hidden)return;

 if(confirm('Chơi lại?')){
  resetGame();
 }
});

// ========================================

// ========================================

</script>
